rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for gout, including an attack affecting the big toe or other joints.

example.english: I had a gout attack last week, and my toe was so swollen I couldn't walk.
example.traditional: 我前排嗰個禮拜痛風發作，隻腳趾腫到行唔到。
example.jyutping: ngo5 cin4 paai2 go2 go3 lai5 baai3 tung3 fung1 faat3 zok3 zek3 goek3 zi2 zung2 dou3 haang4 m4 dou3
